problem: The CVE reachability assessment overstates what the configuration establishes. Line 37 asserts that “the org holds no Grafana-managed alert rules”; line 38 similarly asserts that the repository has no Editors. The supported upgrade preserves Grafana’s database through configure.py:113–119 and ecosystem-grafana.ini.example:2. Missing alerting provisioning and handleGrafanaManagedAlerts:false do not establish the absence of database-backed rules, and allow_sign_up=false plus anonymous Viewer do not establish the absence of existing Editors. The recorded qualification explicitly uses synthetic databases and leaves the real database unexamined, so these categorical absence claims exceed its evidence.
fix: Append a corrected reachability assessment stating that the templates provision no Grafana-managed rules or Editor accounts, and that existing database users, rules, sharing tokens and additional datasources were not inspected. Apply that scope explicitly to all three CVE entries. Preserve the recorded outputs and refresh the registered hash for any corrected artifact.
